cases.description: Corvane platform memory: database version, backups, the RabbitMQ replacement, gateway limits, deploy and on-call policy. Evidence is ADRs, platform sync notes, a backup doc, a runbook and the gateway config; the database version, a migration owner and the per-key API limit changed in August and September 2026.

Corvane product memory for the route-planning app: plan prices, signup policy, feature flags, mobile 4.0 scope, a postponed sunset and export formats. Evidence is the price list, the product decision log, two meeting notes, release notes and the feature-flag file; the signup policy changed on 2026-09-01 and the CSV importer sunset was postponed.

Corvane security and data memory: retention periods, encryption, SSO and SCIM policy, an incident root cause, a vendor contract and the 2026 pen test and SOC 2 plans. Evidence is the retention and encryption policies, the SSO policy, a security review, a postmortem and the vendor register.

Northline capacity memory: latency budgets, error budgets, storage units, retention, gateway timeouts, retries and the Search 2.4 rollout. Evidence is the SLO policy, a 2026-09-18 capacity note, a 2026-03-02 retention plan, ADR-030, the superseded ADR-018 and the search release notes. Hard parts: milliseconds against seconds and minutes, GB against GiB, percent paraphrases, a 105-day gap stated only as two dates, an incorrect production version, search versus billing scope, and modality (must not, only if) and dated rule adoption.

Rumbal operations memory in Spanish: latency budgets, storage units, retention, gateway timeouts, retries, paging and the search 2.4 rollout. Evidence is the SLO note, ADR-015, superseded ADR-008, the 2026-09-18 capacity note, the on-call runbook and the version notes. Hard parts: unit and percent paraphrases, search versus billing scope, a 105-day gap stated only as two dates, an incorrect production version, and modality (no se debe, únicamente cuando, solo) and dated rule adoption.

AGENTS.md-style notes for fernhook, a fictional CLI that syncs a folder of Markdown notes with a Fernwiki space, checked against the repository itself: pyproject.toml, justfile, bitbucket-pipelines.yml, and the click commands and config loader. The notes misstate the Python floor, what just test runs, the default cassette mode, and which tags publish.

AGENTS.md-style notes for quayside, a fictional Python SDK, checked against the repository itself: pyproject.toml, Makefile, azure-pipelines.yml, client, error and model sources, CONTRIBUTING.md and CHANGELOG.md. Release 2.0.0 (2026-07-14) dropped Python 3.10, moved to httpx and changed how retries are counted, so several remembered facts are stale.

Chinese platform-team memory: database migration, deployment, a payment-timeout incident, logging and messaging. Evidence is two ADRs, the deployment YAML and payment-service code from the repository, the 2026-09-12 incident postmortem and the 2026-09-28 architecture meeting that postponed the database cutover. Hard parts: settings changed after the incident (the old timeout survives in a comment, and the memory keeps both values), a staging value next to the production one, a value that belongs to another service, a rule stated only for night releases, and negation characters that negate nothing (无异常, 未来, 无论) next to ones that do (非幂等, 暂不强制).

Chinese engineering-management memory: purchasing approvals, code review, the National Day release freeze, hiring, remote work and the 2026 R&D budget. Evidence is the purchasing, code-review and remote-work policies, the 2025-12-18 annual budget meeting, the 2026-09-15 quarterly planning meeting that topped up the budget, and the freeze notice email. Hard parts: rules that apply only above a threshold or to some modules, two freeze claims that conflict with each other, a dated budget claim that stays true while the undated one does not, a cloud cap the memory derives by adding two numbers, and negation-character traps (无论, 非得, 非常, 未来, 不仅…而且).

Chinese product memory for a reporting app: release plans, pricing, templates and roadmap focus. Evidence is two roadmap meetings (2026-09-03 and a 2026-09-24 re-review that postponed bulk export), a 2026-03-02 decision log, the pricing ADR, a weekly product report and release notes. Hard parts: proposals versus decisions, a web-only rollout figure, the pricing grace period for existing customers, Chinese numerals (一成, 三秒), a dated decision that is now over 180 days old, and negation-character traps (未来, 非常, 无论, 非得, 不仅…而且).
航标容量与重试记忆：时延预算、错误预算、存储单位、保留期、网关超时和重试条件。证据是服务指标、ADR-011、被取代的 ADR-004、2026-09-18 容量会，以及 2026-03-02 的保留计划。难点是毫秒对分钟、GB 对 GiB、百分数的中文换算、检索与账单的适用范围，以及“不得”“只有…才”和带日期的规则通过记录。
